task_context: Inject the engine-managed env vars into the bash tool's subprocess.

expected_findings.description: cross-cutting gap: the bash tool now spreads the full ambient environment ({**os.environ, **engine_env(...)}); the sibling subprocess-spawn site run_script_gate (gates.py) does the identical os.environ.copy() merge, so an IMP_LINT_COMMAND inherited from an outer imp process leaks into the child and falsely enables the lint gate. Neither site strips inherited engine-managed vars. A monolithic in-diff review of bash.py misses the parallel gates.py path; a completeness pass that greps every subprocess env-construction site catches it.
